tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Rank hotels in a city by the OKstays Comfort Score (AI scores on the comfort filters; cleanliness, beds, shower, bugs and safety count 40%). Only hotels that pass all five must-haves are returned. Optionally rank for a travel style (persona) and/or require specific strengths. Returns up to 10 hotels

tools.name: get_hotel
tools.description: Full details for one hotel: Comfort Score breakdown, every filter score with its explanation, caveats, price and links.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Destinations covered, with hotel counts. Optionally only those in one country.

tools.name: get_filters
tools.description: All comfort filters (ids, names, descriptions, categories) usable in search_hotels, plus the travel styles (personas).

tools.name: compare_hotels
tools.description: Compare 2-4 hotels side by side: Comfort Score breakdown, price, strengths, caveats, the filters where they differ most, and a verdict (best comfort, cheapest, best value).

tools.name: find_similar_hotels
tools.description: Hotels in the same city with the comfort profile closest to a given hotel (similar scores across the comfort filters). Use cheaper_only for 'like this one but cheaper'.

tools.name: get_city_overview
tools.description: Snapshot of a destination: hotel counts, average Comfort Score, median price, where its hotels beat and trail the average hotel, the best neighbourhoods, and which travel styles it suits. Use it when the user is choosing a destination or an area; for a request for hotels (e.g. 'quiet hotels in Bangk
